title_en: Discovering stochastic partial differential equations from limited data using variational Bayes inference
title_zh: 用变分贝叶斯从有限数据发现随机偏微分方程

verified_metadata.title: Discovering stochastic partial differential equations from limited data using variational Bayes inference
verified_metadata.journal: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
verified_metadata.abstract: Extended Kramers-Moyal targets and spike-and-slab variational Bayes select sparse drift and diffusion operators for canonical SPDEs from limited ensembles.
verified_metadata.comment: CMAME article cross-checked with arXiv full text

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Yogesh Chandrakant Mathpati、Tapas Tripura、Rajdip Nayek、Souvik Chakraborty；CMAME 418, 116512 (2024)，DOI:10.1016/j.cma.2023.116512。核验 arXiv:2306.15873 全文16页。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: SPDE同时包含空间微分operator、nonlinear drift和state-dependent stochastic diffusion。数据只有少量independent realizations时，怎样构造可回归targets、选择真正的operator terms并量化model/parameter uncertainty？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: 作者扩展Kramers–Moyal：短时间state increment的一阶ensemble moment给drift，二阶moment给diffusion quadratic form。候选library包含u、powers及空间derivatives。
与单轨迹数值微分不同，方法需要同初态或可比较状态下的ensemble responses。发现的diffusion是平方/协方差层面，sign通常不可由二阶矩辨识。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 先由有限trajectories计算drift/diffusion response vectors与library matrix，再用Spike-and-Slab prior为每个候选项引入Bernoulli inclusion variable。mean-field variational Bayes迭代posterior coefficients、inclusion probabilities和noise variance。
阈值化posterior inclusion probability选择structure，posterior mean/std给coefficient uncertainty。案例为stochastic heat、Allen–Cahn和Nagumo，使用不同data fractions与noise settings。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: Figure 1的Allen–Cahn例在42个basis中选择drift的u、u³、u_xx与constant diffusion，系数接近truth；Figure 2显示discovered SPDE的space-time solution及predictive uncertainty。
后续Figures 3–6对heat/Nagumo和multiplicative noise重复结构恢复，并扫描训练量。有限synthetic examples中posterior inclusion清晰，但误差图依赖同一生成模型与numerical protocol。
作者声称limited data优势来自Bayesian sparsity，但没有覆盖高维2D/3D fields、unknown boundary、measurement noise与hidden variables的统一benchmark。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: KM近似要求small Δt、足够ensemble和Itô/Markov假设；finite difference空间导数会放大噪声。library若遗漏真实term或候选高度共线，posterior inclusion不保证物理正确。
Spike-and-Slab VB低估posterior correlation/多峰性风险高于exact Bayes；reported uncertainty主要是所设likelihood内的epistemic estimate，不含model discrepancy和solver bias。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 全文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.15873；期刊：https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cma.2023.116512。PDF SHA-256：828b9b698fddeffa9e4ca7e36d6e4e1837c1bfe2e67d051040f469ffaed27620。正文未给公开代码仓库。

复现需固定Δt、realizations、spatial grid/derivative stencil、library、PIP threshold、prior hyperparameters、VB convergence与SPDE solver seeds。Evidence status: full-text verified theoretical/numerical study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
